name: Screen Sharing
description: Another computer's screen in a desk window over VNC, the protocol macOS Screen Sharing speaks: see it, use its keyboard and pointer, or only watch. The connection is the core's (net.connect), asked for once per computer; passwords are asked each time and never kept.

commands.title: Screen Sharing: Connect to a computer
commands.description: Show another computer's screen: host (a name or an IPv4 address, or vnc://host:port), port (5900 by default), an optional name and user name. Without a host, the form opens for the person.
